# SalesOgre AI

> SalesOgre AI is the next evolution of selling: an AI sales coach for B2B sales teams that makes every seller better, not just faster. It is a revenue system built into sales execution. It reads every deal in real time, coaches the account executive during and after each conversation, scores the forecast against buyer-side evidence, and drafts the next best action. A person approves everything outbound. Built by salespeople who carried a quota.

## Product
- [Home](https://salesogre.com/): What SalesOgre AI does for account executives, sales leaders and their customers.
- [The Platform](https://salesogre.com/platform.html): The capture, read, coach and act loop, and integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail, Outlook, calendar).
- [Pricing](https://salesogre.com/pricing.html): Free ($0, 5 prospects, 5 deals, 5 people, no AI work), Individual License ($59/month, 12-month term), Individual Annual Commit ($1,000/year upfront), Enterprise (custom pricing for teams of 5 or more; contact cj@salesogre.com). Paid through Stripe; every license payment funds the AI Wallet.
- [Integrations](https://salesogre.com/integrations.html): Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail, Outlook and calendar, and what SalesOgre does with that data.
- [AI-R](https://salesogre.com/air/): The AI regulator that SalesOgre runs on. It meters model calls, routes work to the cheapest model that passes a quality bar, reuses cached answers and enforces spending ceilings.

## Guides
- [FAQ](https://salesogre.com/faq.html): Pricing, who SalesOgre is for, human approval on every send, how champions and blockers are read, demos and the founding cohort.
- [What is a revenue system of action?](https://salesogre.com/revenue-system-of-action.html): How a system of action differs from a system of record or insight, and how SalesOgre captures, reads, coaches and acts.
- [MEDDPICC deal scoring explained](https://salesogre.com/meddpicc-deal-scoring.html): Each MEDDPICC letter, what real buyer evidence looks like, warning signs, and how SalesOgre scores deals on events.
- [How to identify a real sales champion](https://salesogre.com/how-to-identify-a-sales-champion.html): Four tests that separate a MEDDPICC champion from a friendly contact, warning signs of polite interest, and how SalesOgre classifies stakeholders.
- [Sales forecast accuracy](https://salesogre.com/sales-forecast-accuracy.html): Why forecasts built on seller activity miss, which buyer evidence to count instead, and a five-question weekly check for commit deals.
- [How to map a B2B buying committee](https://salesogre.com/buying-committee-mapping.html): The roles that decide, influence and review a purchase, how to map them in four steps, and the gaps that stall deals.
- [Why deals end in no decision](https://salesogre.com/no-decision-deals.html): What a no-decision loss is, its common root causes, and the early buyer signals of a stalled deal.
- [AI sales coaching that keeps the rep in charge](https://salesogre.com/ai-sales-coaching.html): What AI coaching should do before, during and after a meeting, with every outbound message approved by a person.
- [MEDDPICC software](https://salesogre.com/meddpicc-software.html): What MEDDPICC software should do, five questions to ask any vendor, and how SalesOgre AI scores MEDDPICC from buyer evidence.
- [Deal intelligence software](https://salesogre.com/deal-intelligence-software.html): What deal intelligence is, which buyer signals matter, what to ask vendors, and how SalesOgre AI reads every deal.
